description: Static robot values the Auriga worker reads from the simulator, frozen from the same dumps.

sources.physics_dt_s: RoboDojo env_cfg/sim/sim_config.yml dt (0.004), decimation 1; worker: env.dt
sources.arm_joint_limits_rad: X5A.urdf <limit> (joint1-5 +-10, joint6 +-3.14), float32 in the sim; worker: asset.data.soft_joint_pos_limits
sources.arm_velocity_limit_rad_s: RoboDojo env/robot_manager/robot_config/x5.py:41 velocity_limit_sim=5.0 (URDF says 1000); worker: asset.data.joint_vel_limits
sources.arm_max_step_rad: min(velocity / control_hz, 0.05) (robot_worker.py:125; 0.05 is an Auriga constant)
sources.gripper: Assets/Robots/x5/robot_config.yml gripper_scale / gripper_move; URDF joint7/joint8 limits [0, 0.044]
sources.native_step_limit_by_task: RoboDojo task/RoboDojo/tasks/<task>.py self.step_lim (local copy 726e9aa); worker: env.step_lim

capabilities_reference.note: worker capabilities() from the reference dump (motion_safety_guard and trajectory_preview on, resampled mode); action_budget.native_step_limit is per task, see native_step_limit_by_task

waypoint_speed_scales.semantics: one resolved scale per waypoint, overriding top-level speed_scale; omitted list inherits top-level for all segments

action_speed.semantics: resampled joint-command spacing; top-level speed_scale supplies the default, with optional per-waypoint overrides; no physical speed guarantee
action_speed.resampling: scale 1 preserves legacy sampling; other scales preserve significant turns within 0.001 rad per joint and bound adjacent command deltas by scaled nominal and native velocity limits
action_speed.gripper: scale below 1 ramps from measured opening then retains legacy final-goal dwell; during_motion scales the synchronized ramp limit; direct after_motion jaws compile from fresh measured opening after successful arrival, within the shared request cap; exact cached previews keep their rows and reject gripper_start_state_changed if the old first jaw step exceeds the bound
action_speed.accounting: 25 Hz native actions and physics ticks unchanged; slower commands consume more native steps within the same 10 s request cap

motion_safety_guard.scope: resampled segments before dispatch; no wrapping or automatic replanning

trajectory_preview.scope: single-segment candidate joint/FK timeline; robot-model near-approach only; no task-object truth

value.dual_arm_semantics: paired default checks both endpoints at each waypoint barrier; independent advances each arm after its own measured arrival and starts its own after_motion jaw, with final held-endpoint recheck; both initial plans precede dispatch; one merged row per native step, one shared 10 s cap; no joint collision or held-object constraint guarantee
value.waypoint_semantics: sequential native plans with endpoint verification; no blending or linear Cartesian guarantee
value.waypoint_failure_semantics: prior waypoints may already have executed when a later plan fails; receipt retains partial motion
value.native_evaluator: privileged IPC only; never actor observation

gripper_semantics.during_motion: linear ramp from latched goal (measured opening for gripper_speed_scale below 1) over start_fraction..end_fraction of final segment native steps; uniformly subdivide motion if needed for command rate limits; command completion does not prove measured opening or grasp

tool_geometry.source: pinned ARX X5 URDF gripping-face geometry, not task object state

contact_depth_m.positive_direction: from distal pad toward palm along local -x

contact_selection.semantics: grasp_position_m targets the selected cross-section between fingers; omitted selection uses the distal 15 mm pad center. finger_middle is the nominal midpoint of the exposed inner face, on its sloped portion. References do not certify clearance, contact or retention.
contact_selection.observation_reference: robot_state.arms[arm].grasp_pose always remains pad_center; receipt.grasp_contact_feedback reports the selected reference from the terminal measured link6 pose.

tool_geometry.conversion: p_grasp = p_link6 + R(quaternion_xyzw) @ offset. robot_action stages use kind='move' with a unique id and arm. position_m plus quaternion_xyzw targets link6; alternatively grasp_position_m plus angles_deg targets the selected grasp section. Both pose forms use the same public move stage; no separate EE tool or manual grasp offset is needed.

bounded_wait.semantics: hold both measured arm joint positions and last gripper goals; each step consumes one native action, not wall-clock sleep

joint_prefix.timing: one official native action per row

value.clock_policy: physics advances only in the worker's bounded execution; paused during agent reasoning
value.cancellation: checked before dispatch and between native actions; native planning is not interruptible
value.collision_scope: native robot self-collision and configured static planner table; no task-object or other-arm collision proof

motion_preview.semantics: read-only native planning; exact cached resampled plan, single use, rejected after state changes; cached after_motion jaw rows are never rebased and can stop with gripper_start_state_changed after arm motion

unified_action.checkpoint_resume: validate current measured state then retain exact cached suffix; never replan
unified_action.planning: complete stage graph, future starts from prior commanded endpoints without physics
